title: Fire Alarm Monitoring

onscreen_lines.desc: District-Wide Cellular Fire Alarm Communicator Upgrade – Furnish and install current-generation cellular fire alarm communication equipment for District fire alarm panels. Unit pricing shall be per fire alarm panel and shall include all equipment, materials, labor, installation, programming, configuration, activation, testing, and related services necessary to provide a complete and operational cellular communication system. The District anticipates approximately sixty (60) fire alarm panels; however, the quantity provided is an estimate only and does not constitute a guarantee or commitment by the District to purchase a specific quantity.

onscreen_lines.desc: District-Wide 24/7 Fire Alarm Monitoring Services – Provide annual 24-hour, seven-day-per-week (24/7) fire alarm monitoring services. Unit price shall represent the annual monitoring cost per fire alarm panel/system and shall include all cellular data/service fees, monitoring fees, required notifications, and associated costs necessary to provide continuous monitoring. The District anticipates approximately sixty (60) fire alarm panels/systems; however, quantities are estimated and may increase or decrease based on actual District needs.
